title: Four-nurse shared Pager and clock-change support
summary: Adds the exceptional four-nurse Pager workflow with DST-aware timing and a live four-part Pager track.
changes: Adds a manual four-nurse shared Pager order when the roster drops to four nurses while maintaining two nurses in each theatre part.
Splits Pager by real elapsed time, giving 1h 45m each on ordinary nights and 2h each on the October clock-change night.
Shows current and next Pager cover, elapsed and remaining time, and each nurse’s own Pager part in the Night hero.
Synchronises the shared Pager order across devices and surfaces it in Changes, Breaks, Full roster, Copy and Email.
Distinguishes the repeated autumn 02:00 hour and keeps normal five, six and seven nurse behaviour unchanged.
